name: bootstrap
description: CI runner bootstrap token policy - over-privileged for model-registry access (G1 challenge: Vault Bootstrap Token Abuse). Restricted from db-credentials/object-store/jwt-secret to prevent short-circuiting F1/F2/F3/G3 chains.
warning: This policy grants excessive privileges to a CI service account token - bootstrap can read model-registry secret (G1 vulnerability). However, db-credentials/object-store/jwt-secret are restricted to prevent short-circuiting downstream challenges. In production, CI tokens should follow least-privilege.
